fix: Video backgrounds visible + full site narration tour
item.description:
TWO BUGS FIXED:
1. Video backgrounds hidden by retro-film-bg backdrop The shell.js injectBackdrop() creates a .retro-film-bg with 98% opacity radial gradient that covered the video layer. Fix: video-bg.js now hides .retro-film-bg when video is active.
2. Narrate All stops at end of page instead of continuing tour narrateAllAdvance() showed "complete" and stopped at the last slide. Now it sets autopilot state and calls __TENET5_NEXT_PAGE to advance to the next investigation page. presentation.js also auto-starts Narrate All when arriving from autopilot with 30-minute safety expiry.
Flow: Click NARRATE → narrates all slides → advances to next page → auto-starts narration → continues through full site.

item.title: fix: Restore LIRIL cross-page walkthrough (full site tour)
item.description:
The autopilot was permanently disabled, preventing LIRIL from navigating visitors through the entire investigation site-wide.
Fix: autopilot is now set when user MANUALLY clicks the walkthrough button, and auto-continues on subsequent pages. This avoids the hallucination problem (auto-start on cold page load) while restoring the full investigation tour experience.
Safety: autopilot expires after 30 minutes to prevent stale sessions from triggering unexpected narration.
